guest_wilds.configuration.title: Guest Wilds
guest_wilds.configuration.paths.tooltip: Walking entities and unobserved traffic trample grass into paths that regrow when unused.
guest_wilds.configuration.wearMultiplier: Scales how quickly routes turn into paths.
guest_wilds.configuration.lairs.tooltip: Caves hold persistent hostile populations that grow, compete and migrate.
guest_wilds.configuration.suppressRandom: Skeleton riders only appear from long-established mixed spider and skeleton lairs.
guest_wilds.configuration.undeadDailyCyc: Undead leave their lairs at dusk and seek cover before dawn instead of burning.
guest_wilds.configuration.fogShieldsUnde: Undead do not burn in fog and can hunt during a foggy day.
guest_wilds.configuration.herds.tooltip: Wild animals live in herds led by a leader: fewer, larger herds that graze, drink, migrate and change in number while unobserved.
guest_wilds.configuration.herdRelocation: Animals left behind by a migrating herd rejoin it when their area loads again.
guest_wilds.configuration.grazersEatGras: Cows and goats eat grass like sheep do.
guest_wilds.configuration.weatherShelter: Herds follow their leader under cover in rain and blizzards; spiders and creepers retreat to their lairs during severe storms.
guest_wilds.configuration.seasonalVarian: Husks, strays, parched, bogged, winter coats and chicken variants follow place and season.
guest_wilds.configuration.fishShoals.too: Fishing depends on local shoals that deplete and regrow; large shoals give several fish per cast.
guest_wilds.configuration.endermenPlaces: Overworld endermen gather on heights and near strongholds, ancient cities, ruined portals and other ancient structures.
guest_wilds.configuration.endermenElsewh: Share of enderman spawns still allowed away from places of power.
guest_wilds.command.overworld_only: Guest Wilds only simulates the Overworld.
guest_wilds.command.lair: Lair: entrance %s (seen from %s), den %s (%s blocks lower), openness %s, %s cells, %s days old, %s traces, spider riders: %s.
guest_wilds.command.herd: Herd of %s: %s animals (%s seen) grazing at %s, vegetation %s, drinking place %s, leader present: %s, wolf packs nearby %s.
guest_wilds.command.shoal.none: Stand in water to inspect its shoal.
guest_wilds.command.shoal: %s shoal: %s of %s fish, salmon share %s, %s visible; this water gives %s.
guest_wilds.command.route: Posted route traffic: %s trips, %s blocks wide, %s waypoints.
guest_wilds.command.simulate: Advanced %s days and caught the wilds up.
guest_wilds.configuration.lairShare: Share of cave entrances with a lair
guest_wilds.configuration.lairShare.tool: How many of the cave entrances found in newly loaded land become somebody's lair (0.5 = about half).
guest_wilds.configuration.surfaceSpawnSh: Share of vanilla night spawns of zombies, skeletons, spiders and creepers still allowed on the surface; the rest come out of lairs. Caves, spawners, witches and endermen are unaffected. 1 = vanilla.
guest_wilds.configuration.lairFights.too: Two species sharing a cave fight when both are out; the weaker one flees.
guest_wilds.configuration.clutchExplodes: The egg clutch in a creeper lair explodes when trampled or broken.
guest_wilds.configuration.fishSchoolSize: How many fish can follow one school leader (vanilla: 8 cod, 5 salmon).
guest_wilds.configuration.fishingByPlace: Water over wrecks and ruins gives their relics; open water gives only fish. No junk is ever caught.
guest_wilds.configuration.forestRegrowth: Stumps of felled trees scrub over with a bush and later sprout a sapling of the same wood.
guest_wilds.command.lairs: %s known lairs within %s blocks. This session: %s chunks scanned, %s cave entrances found, %s lairs founded, %s chunks skipped (players live there), %s ms per scanned chunk, %s residents per scanned chunk.
guest_wilds.command.route.bad: Waypoints must look like "x y z; x y z; ..." or be "surface".
guest_wilds.command.regrowth: %s felled stumps are regrowing; nearest at %s (stage %s, felled %s days ago).
